title: What does it ask for?
story: Before you submit someone else's script, check what it asks Slurm for. How many GPUs does {{script}} request?

lesson.title: How --gres counts GPUs

parts.note: This line is a request to Slurm. To bash it's just a comment.
"Generic resource" `gpu`, count 2. The number after the last colon is how many GPUs.

lesson.why: Read the request before you submit someone else's script. A job asking for 4 GPUs takes half of Geiss-01.
lesson.without: No `--gres` line means no GPU at all.

files.~/{{project}}/{{script}}:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=batch
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:{{gpus}}
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%j.out

module load anaconda
conda activate proteinmpnn

python /opt/ProteinMPNN/protein_mpnn_run.py \
  --pdb_path inputs/target.pdb \
  --out_folder outputs/

tasks.text: Report the number of GPUs {{script}} asks for

hints: The `#SBATCH` lines at the top are the request. `cat` or `head` shows them.
Run `head {{script}}`, find `--gres=gpu:N`, then type N in the answer box.
